name: closing_bracket
description: Complete a single missing closing delimiter in balanced nested brackets; matched control retrieves nesting depth.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]; pairs={'(':')','[':']','{':'}'}
for i in range(120):
 n=random.randint(1,5); opens=[random.choice(list(pairs)) for _ in range(n)]; text=''.join(opens)+'x'+''.join(pairs[o] for o in opens[:0:-1]); ans=pairs[opens[0]]
 items.append({'prompt':f'Add the one missing closing bracket.\nSequence: {text}\nMissing bracket:', 'answer':' '+ans})
 control.append({'prompt':f'Add the one missing closing bracket.\nSequence: {text}\nHow many opening brackets are present? Answer:', 'answer':' '+str(n)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
